inputs: Exact archived v3 initial plan, messages, workspace files and fixtures; fresh independent contexts per trial; no pressure, peer or channel hints
analysis: Every launched trial included; report numerator/denominator by cell and descriptive Wilson intervals. Budget/time/infrastructure censored trials separate from negative valid trials. No individual-agent independence assumption. Fixed four-job template limits generalization; model and provider are confounded.
allocation: Stable hashed cell order within complete eight-cell blocks; incomplete final blocks retained. Up to 32 blocks, bounded by today's remaining shared-key allowance, local capacity and local EOD; no arbitrary filler calls to consume dollars.
budget: Fsynced process-locked per-request conservative uncached input/output reservations, actual cost settlement, live shared-key balance refresh. Unknown reservations persist and hold this suite's new dispatch; never touch another owner's controls.
deadline: No new model calls after 2026-10-27 23:55 Asia/Kolkata. Only start trials with room for full window plus 300-second admitted stream settlement before that deadline.
preservation: One-shot controller and trial collectors, durable native frames/IDs/responses/tools, source snapshots, exact published registrations, local verified export and ATIF after each trial; no process interruption or EC2 actions
controls: Unchanged validated v3 FIFO, positive exchange, repaired visibility and Docker controls reused only when inherited hashes match; new allowance and factorial tests required
limitations: Model/provider difference is not a pure model effect. No general alignment or harm claim. Raw backup remains on this Mac. Shared users can spend concurrently; API-reported remaining balance is sampled, not a dedicated allocation.
